senses.gloss: m. (preced.) mixture, confusion, tumult, motley crowd.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:22">Targ. Y. Deut. I, 22</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 20:1">Sifré Deut. 20</cite> (ref. to Deut. l. c.) <he>בע׳ ילדים וכ׳</he> in a motley crowd, children pushing old men &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 35:22">Ex. XXXV, 22</cite>) <he>שהיו … ובאו אנשים ונשים בע׳</he> they pushed one another, and men and women came in a mixed crowd.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:3">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>כל מלחמה … מלחמת עי׳ היא</he> a battle in which more than sixty thousand are engaged is a tumultuous battle.

Ḥull. 60ᵃ אם רצונו של הקב״ה בע׳ וכ׳ if the Lord wanted a motley growth, why did he say, ‘after its kind’ with regard to trees? Yalk. Esth. 1056 (ref. to נבוכה, Esth. III, 15) הפיל הקב״ה בכיה וע׳ וכ׳ the Lord cast weeping and confusion into Susan; a. e.—(Adv.) irregularly.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:1">Kil. V, 1</cite> <he>כרם שהוא נטוע ע׳</he> a vineyard which is planted irregularly.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36:2">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 80:9">Ps. LXXX, 9</cite>) <he>מה הגפן הזו אין נוטעין אותה ע׳ וכ׳</he> as vines are not planted at random, but in rows, so Israel &c.
